component: Qwen4 QSA stage-one keys-stationary scorer and one-workgroup selector candidates
license_basis: Source repository LICENSE at the recorded revision
modifications: Reimplemented the CUDA/HIP key-stationary scheduling idea as a separate Metal Performance Primitives scorer: one workgroup retains a 32-key tile in threadgroup memory while walking all 16-query tiles.

Kept mlx2's existing FP16/BF16 inputs, 16x32x16 cooperative-matrix accumulation order, ReLU and four-head epilogue, exact-band repair, and exact radix selector; no upstream CUDA/HIP kernel code was copied.
Added an independent default-off MLX_QWEN4_QSA_STAGE1_KEYS_STATIONARY gate and minimum-query threshold. Unsupported or unselected geometries retain the existing MPP or MLX scorer.

Reimplemented the one-workgroup selector idea with a 12-bit threshold histogram, bounded candidate compaction, two 10-bit refinement passes, overflow rescans, mlx2's larger-block-ID tie rule, and ascending output canonicalization.
Added an independent default-off MLX_QWEN4_QSA_STAGE1_ONEPASS_TOPK gate and minimum-block threshold; the existing exact eight-pass radix selector remains the default and fallback.
Added bounded stage-one scorer and selector receipts to FlashNext diagnostics so qualification can prove actual candidate engagement.
Kept both candidates default-off after qualification. The keys-stationary scorer did not meet the benefit gate; the one-workgroup selector is rejected for performance.
validation: A Python harness set mx.set_default_device(mx.cpu) before invoking the focused candidate tests (9 passed).
Fatal Python lint on all changed Python files, git diff --check, JSON parsing, and Python compileall passed.

On Apple M5 Max with MLX 0.32.2.dev20260919+39400a0d4, the Metal qualification covered FP16 and BF16 scorer parity, distinct scores, ties, oversized threshold buckets, partial validity, padding, exact-band repair, and full-route parity.
The final benchmark uses five warmups and fifty rotating interleaved repetitions at 65,024 tokens with 64 and 512 query rows and at 98,304 tokens with 64 query rows.

qualification.keys_stationary: exact but not qualified for benefit; median 2.23 percent scorer gain with a 1.62 to 5.15 percent range, below the 3 percent component gate; median full-route gain 0.70 percent with a -0.44 to +0.89 percent range, below the 3 percent route gate; unselected and not observed-used in production
qualification.onepass_topk: exact but rejected; selector 3.5 to 4.4 times the radix cost and full route 2.0 to 2.8 times baseline; unselected and not observed-used in production
